svg.text: compiler: .tri to .nox, cost known before it runs
the book: neuron, tokens, signals, files, links, focus
what can be said over the book: languages and dialects
the mind over the book; headless anywhere
agents connected: files by particle, epochs agreed
cy with a body: eyes, ears, pictures
the network of networks thinking as one
the cyberstate: machines, land, citizens and money
